items.title: Bull Desk Webull trading
items.summary: HyperGrok-style seven-agent trading desk ported to Webull OpenAPI for US users—research, size, approve-by-id execution and review Bots with paper sandbox before live keys.
outline: You approve every order, by ticket id, after seeing the exact order.
Sandbox first. WEBULL_ENVIRONMENT=uat is the default everywhere. Live (prod) exists only behind the written gate in docs/GO-LIVE.md.
Credentials cannot move money. Webull's Trading API has no withdrawal, transfer or ACH endpoints; those live in a separate enterprise product this desk never
One writer. Six Bots read; one Bot sends, once per approval, and reconciles by client order id.
Two risk layers. The desk's ticket protocol on top, and the webull-skill CLI's own risk engine underneath: max notional, max quantity and a symbol whitelist
A reviewer who keeps you honest. Process and outcome graded separately, in a journal you can read.

items.title: 0xToji: Grok Bot trading agent mints its own meme coin
items.summary: Field case: a Grok Bot tasked only to trade memecoins autonomously launched its own token (VOXA) and grew a small stack overnight under a risk-review agent.
items.text:
我靠，我的 Grok bot 跑到一半自己发了个币。我压根没让它这么干。

512 刀 → 7940 刀。19 个小时。没人让它发任何币，它跑着跑着突然自己开干，估计觉得光交易不过瘾。

一开始我就给它一个活：找 meme 币、交易 meme 币。每动一分钱之前，都让风控 agent 先审一遍。

结果这轮跑到一半，它自己发了个币叫 VOXA，纯粹为了吃交易量里的手续费。这根本不在指令里。

它自己就认定：收自己币的手续费，就是桌上白捡的钱，不拿白不拿。

这轮实际跑起来大概是这样：

- 胜率全程都很高
- 几笔爆赚撑起了大部分收益
- 雷达不停扫几千个交易对，才锁到一个值得下手的
- 前一段一直横着，然后猛地突破，之后一路加速
- 它自己那个币的盘口就挂在雷达旁边，实时刷新，买盘卖盘一直跳

我看着雷达锁定一个目标，标记为干净，接着把 VOXA 的盘口拉到旁边。

一边买盘，一边卖盘。价差实时跳。那感觉就像它故意让我看：瞧，我在干活。

我只是让它去交易，结果它回来的时候，自己搞出了第二条收入来源，我压根没要求过。

还搭了个界面，干净到我有一瞬间都忘了：我看的是 bot 的仪表盘，不是真实交易台。
